content_data.meeting_title: Visual Strategy Alignment for 'Echoes of Europe' Campaign
agenda_items: Discussion on brand guidelines integration for new media formats
Review of initial mood boards and conceptual directions
Resource allocation for upcoming visual asset production
Client feedback synthesis and creative adaptations
key_decisions: Confirmed the need for a dedicated photoshoot for core visual assets, focusing on authentic European landscapes and diversity.
Established a bi-weekly creative review cycle with the client for expedited feedback and iteration.
Approved 'Heritage Fusion' as the primary visual theme, emphasizing modern interpretation of classic European motifs.
Agreed to prioritize motion graphics and interactive elements for digital channels to enhance user engagement.
action_items: Develop detailed storyboards for the 'Heritage Fusion' video series by next week. (Assigned to: Anya Sharma)
Research and propose three photographers specializing in European landscape and cultural portraiture within 5 days. (Assigned to: Marc Dubois)
Schedule a workshop with the content team to align on visual storytelling narratives within the next 10 days. (Assigned to: Creative Lead)
Update brand guideline adaptation document to include specifications for AR/VR content by end of next period. (Assigned to: Elara Vance)
